name: Coye Law Firm
about: Coye Law Firm is a personal injury firm with a single office in Orlando.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

ahrefs.source: Ahrefs Site Explorer, batch endpoint, subdomains mode, organic figures for the United States

G1.evidence: Florida does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.evidence: This firm names no attorney on the pages we could read, so there is nobody to look up. The register itself exists: Florida publishes its attorney discipline as court decisions and we read them for the other firms in this market.

G3.evidence: No matching active entity in the Florida corporate register. Florida does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to register, so this is a check we could not complete from this source rather than evidence against the firm
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations, partial
G3.unresolvable: Florida does not require every law firm to register, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, no attorney is named on the site we could read. The gate also asks for no misleading claims, which is an editorial read we have not recorded.

G6.evidence: 314 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2000-09-05, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

score.verdict: 1 eligibility gate(s) still to be checked. 3 could not be answered from the available records (G1, G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar A (0/25).

subs.label: Experience
subs.evidence: Florida publishes no attorney register we can query, so years since admission cannot be established here for any firm and this is not scored.

subs.label: Roster verifiability
subs.evidence: Our crawl found no roster on this firm's site, so there is nothing here to verify against a register. Publishing one, or telling us where it is, is what gate G5 asks for.

subs.label: Accountability
subs.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

subs.label: Results published
subs.evidence: 2 results published on the firm's own site, counted from stated amounts

subs.label: Specificity
subs.evidence: 5 case types named; no court or county named, so no result can be looked up

subs.label: Results disclosure
subs.evidence: Prior-results disclaimer present beside the published results

subs.label: Authentic volume
subs.evidence: 314 Google reviews · Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

subs.label: Rating quality
subs.evidence: Google rating 4.7 over 314 reviews → Bayesian 4.73 (prior 4.83 weighted as 100 reviews, from 1501 scored firms) · single platform, Google only

subs.label: Review recency
subs.evidence: 5 of 5 sampled reviews are from the last 12 months (newest 2026-10-11) · a sample of five per business listing, not every review

subs.label: Complaint share
subs.evidence: 0 of 5 sampled reviews rate 1 or 2 stars · a sample, so this is the shape of the complaints rather than a count of them

subs.label: Website trust & experience
subs.evidence: CWV pass · no fee statement · privacy policy · no disclaimer · fresh content · scored out of 5 of the 7: nothing has measured accessibility or bar numbers on bios here yet, so it is not counted against this firm

subs.label: Search authority
subs.evidence: DR 31.0 → 82th pct of 92-firm cohort (median 12) 2/3 · 1,588 referring domains, 84th pct 2/2 · 14 organic keywords / 34 visits·mo, 34th pct 1/2 · brand demand 0/1 (pending)

subs.label: Local presence
subs.evidence: 1 operational Google Business Profile listing · 10 or more photos, which is where the API stops counting · 5 categories, hours published, which almost every listing here has and so separates nobody · the services list, Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the Places API does not expose, and NAP consistency across citations and local-pack rank have no source here, so the rest of this sub-factor leaves the scale rather than being scored as unearned

subs.label: Content, E-E-A-T & schema
subs.evidence: JSON-LD detected 1/1 · not assessed on any firm yet, so content depth and earned media and AI citations leave the scale (4 pts)

subs.label: Free consult & fee transparency
subs.evidence: Free consultation · Contingency · the fee percentage itself is not published

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date
